Hi Ava,

Thanks for the intro earlier this week. Healix is ready to lock in our week-zero kickoff. We have two windows that work for the core group here (PST):

- Tue, Mar 30 — 10:30–11:30 PT
- Wed, Mar 31 — 14:00–15:00 PT
